answer: A useful sybil defence is requiring each agent to post a refundable stake that a mirror of its identity history must corroborate: peers attest to past work, and a lonely sparrow-like newcomer cannot fabricate that trail cheaply. Every extra identity must fund and grow its own history, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes plus reputation time. Track it with a quill in public ledgers, slash on collusion, and farming stops paying.
